def cook_chicken():
	#0.Place Pan on Stove
	NAVIGATE_TO('Pan')
	GRASP('Pan')
	NAVIGATE_TO('Stove')
	PLACE_ON_TOP('Stove')
	#1.Place Chicken in Pan and Start Stove
	NAVIGATE_TO('Chicken')
	GRASP('Chicken')
	NAVIGATE_TO('Pan')
	PLACE_INSIDE('Pan')
	NAVIGATE_TO('Stove')
	TOGGLE_ON('Stove')
	#2.Wait untill chiken is cooked
	wait(100.0)
	#3.Turn Off Stove after Cooking Chicken
	NAVIGATE_TO('Stove')
	TOGGLE_OFF('Stove')
	#4.Done
